verses.gurmukhi: ਪਥਰ ਚਿਤੁ ਕਠੋਰੁ ਹੈ ਚੂਨਾਂ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਗੀ ਦਧਾ।
verses.translit_en: pathar chit kaThor hai choonaa(n) hovai agee dhadhaa|

en.bdb: When the hard hearted stone is burnt, it turns into lime stone. sprinkling of  water extinguishes fire

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਗ ਬੁਝੈ ਜਲੁ ਛਿੜਕਿਐ ਚੂਨਾ ਅਗਿ ਉਠੈ ਅਤਿ ਵਧਾ।
verses.translit_en: ag bujhai jal chhiRakiaai choonaa ag uThai at vadhaa|

en.bdb: But in the case of lime water produces great heat.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਣੀ ਪਾਏ ਵਿਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਛੁਟੈ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਬਧਾ।
verses.translit_en: paanee paae vih na jai agan na chhuTai avagun badhaa|

en.bdb: Its poison does not go away even if water is thrown on it and its foul fire remains in it .

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੀਭੈ ਉਤੈ ਰਖਿਆ ਛਾਲੇ ਪਵਨਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਦੁਖ ਲਧਾ।
verses.translit_en: jeebhai utai rakhiaa chhaale pavan sa(n)g dhukh ladhaa|

en.bdb: If put on tongue, it creates painful blisters.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਨ ਸੁਪਾਰੀ ਕਥੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਸੁਰੰਗੁ ਸੰਪੂਰਣੁ ਸਧਾ।
verses.translit_en: paan supaaree kath mil ra(n)g sura(n)g sa(n)pooran sadhaa|

en.bdb: But getting company of betel leaf, betel nut and catechu its colour becomes bright, beautiful and completely refined.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੁ ਹੋਇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਹਾ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਮਧਾ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat mil saadh hoi gurmukh mahaa asaadh samadhaa|

en.bdb: Similarly joining the holy congregation becoming holy men, the gurmukhs get rid of even the chronic ailments.
When the ego is lost, God is visualized even in half a moment.
